hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. brain.commentary: Risk-on regime is offset by weak, barely positive signals and modest conviction. BTC is the strongest-supported long, while ETH and SOL carry higher volatility and weak or negative alpha. LTC is fragile and should remain de-emphasized. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are especially fragile because identical fallback-like signals report zero volatility, zero expected shortfall, and no liquidity or institutional differentiation; treat their long readings as unvalidated rather than constructive.
